notes: The directive he takes a word of its own ('to') because the ASV writes one for it, leaving the toponym its own token (rule 32).
אֲשֶׁר takes 'that' separately and בָּהּ fuses to 'therein', which carries both the relation and the resumption (rule 22); the prepositional predicate carries the clause's supplied 'were' (rule 49).
